name: multicam-video-preprocessing
description: Universal multi-camera video processing pipeline and AI editing suite for 2 to 6 cameras. Features FFT audio time alignment, EBU R128 loudness normalization, multi-in-one grid composition, Gemini 3.8 Flash Agentic Video zero-split full pipeline, FCP7 XML timeline export, and millisecond-accurate YouTube subtitles generation (Whisper + Gemini Proofreading).
